intro.label: Introduction
intro.title: A reliable chain from sourcing to export
intro.p1: Negah Sabz Holding works to develop international trade and bring high-quality Iranian products to regional and global markets. Through a reliable chain of sourcing, processing, manufacturing, packaging, quality control and export, we deliver Iranian products with the right standards and packaging to our clients and trade partners.
intro.p2: The team’s experience in trading and exporting food products — from coffee and instant beverages to export dates, pistachios, saffron and milk powder — supports broad activity across very different markets.

story.label: The story
story.title: From Khorasan, for the world
story.p1: Negah Sabz was founded to develop international trade and introduce high-quality Iranian products to regional and global markets. We build a reliable chain of sourcing, processing, manufacturing, packaging, quality control and export — delivering Iranian products with the right standards and packaging to clients and partners across international markets.
story.p2: With more than 20 years of exporting Iranian products and sales offices in Russia, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan and Oman, Negah Sabz Holding begins every partnership on the basis of mutual collaboration in export and import.
story.p3: Among the holding’s activities are building a coffee processing plant for coffee and powdered coffee products, and a fully automated date sorting and export packaging plant.

facilities.label: Industrial infrastructure
facilities.title: Plants and packaging lines
facilities.p1: Owning dedicated food production and packaging lines is one of the group’s most important capacities — enabling tighter control over quality, packaging and the preparation of domestic and export orders.
facilities.p2: The packaging lines prepare products in a variety of weights, sizes and formats, so orders are matched to client specifications and destination markets.
facilities.list1: Specialized coffee roasting in eastern Iran
facilities.list4: Hygienic packaging tailored to each market

coffee.label: Coffee & beverages
coffee.title: The specialized coffee roastery
coffee.p1: Negah Sabz’s Mashhad roastery — equipped with smart roasting machinery, a specialist team and deep industry experience — is among the largest and longest-running roasting operations in eastern Iran.
coffee.p2: Using intelligent roasting equipment and skilled staff, the plant tailors roasting to bean type, flavour profile and customer requirements, and releases its coffee under the Suncreez brand.

markets.label: Target markets
markets.title: Present across regional and global markets
markets.sub: Mazafati, Piarom and Kaluteh dates reach more than 20 countries; Shadiar saffron is exported to the UAE, Iraq, China, Hong Kong, Australia, Europe, Canada and the US.

certs.label: Documents & certificates
certs.title: Quality credentials
certs.sub: Documents published in the company’s official gallery (ISO 22000, DNV ISO 9001, TUV Iran).

values.label: Philosophy
values.title: We are not here to sell just one product
values.p: Our goal is a durable collaboration — from product selection to production or sourcing, quality control, packaging, order preparation, trade documentation and shipment. Along this path, product quality, supply consistency, appropriate packaging and precise coordination of the export process are the principles of our work.
values.futureP: Negah Sabz uses its plant, production and packaging capacity and its Iranian supply network to strengthen the link between the Iranian producer and the international buyer. Successful export is more than shipping goods — it is a combination of quality, sustainable supply, the right packaging and market insight.
